```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'  # Every 6 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout airbyte repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: airbyte

      - name: Checkout airbyte-ai-connectors repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-ai-connectors
          path: airbyte-ai-connectors

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Get Octavia bot token
        id: octavia_token
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: github.com
          audience: github.com
          scope: repo
          policy: |
            {
              "Version": "2022-10-19",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "github:pull_request:create",
                    "github:pull_request:update",
                    "github:repository:contents:write"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "*"
                }
              ]
            }

      - name: Sync docs
        id: sync
        run: |
          cd airbyte
          
          # Define source and destination directories
          SRC_DIR="../airbyte-ai-connectors/connectors"
          DEST_DIR="docs/ai-agents/connectors"
          
          # Create destination directory if it doesn't exist
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          
          # Remove existing files to ensure clean sync
          rm -rf "$DEST_DIR"/*
          
          # Copy all markdown files from each connector directory
          find "$SRC_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -exec basename {} \; | while read -r connector_dir; do
            echo "Processing connector: $connector_dir"
            src_connector_path="$SRC_DIR/$connector_dir"
            dest_connector_path="$DEST_DIR/$connector_dir"
            
            # Create destination connector directory
            mkdir -p "$dest_connector_path"
            
            # Copy all .md files from source to destination
            find "$src_connector_path" -name "*.md" -exec cp {} "$dest_connector_path/" \;
          done
          
          # Check if there are any changes
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected"
            echo "changes_detected=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Changes detected"
            echo "changes_detected=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.sync.outputs.changes_detected == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.octavia_token.outputs.token }}
          path: airbyte
          commit-message: "chore: sync AI connector docs from airbyte-ai-connectors"
          title: "chore: sync AI connector docs from airbyte-ai-connectors"
          body: "Automated PR to sync AI connector documentation from airbyte-ai-connectors repository.\n\nThis PR was automatically created by a GitHub Actions workflow."
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs-${{ github.run_id }}
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            documentation
            auto-merge
```
